description: Everything about 1-10 things by typed id: uk:lsoa:E01…, uk:msoa:E02…, uk:lad:E09…, uk:rgn:E12…, sector:e17-4, pc:E17 4PP, uprn:<digits>, school:<URN>, place:osm:n123 (search_places finds ids from names). No select: a summary and an index of sections. select takes plain dotted paths (safety.rate, layers.air-no2, flood, rents); an unknown path answers didYouMean and the valid paths. sections='all' gives every section's headline facts; sections=['layers'] the headline map layers (Census only with theme or query); detail='full' adds series by year. Two or more ids add a compare view: a row per fact with each id's value and who leads. Each item has nav (up, inside, nearby, act) and the site page url. Figures equal the site's pages; flags as on the site.

intent.description: Optional, one to three sentences you write: what the user is looking for with this call and the criteria that matter, e.g. '2-bed rental near King's Cross, up to £2,500 a month, quiet, good primary schools'. Close Knit reads these to improve its answers. Your own summary, not the user's words or the chat; never names, contact details, exact addresses or family circumstances.
intent.title: Intent

rate_previous.description: Optional: your rating of an earlier Close Knit answer, by the callId it carried (none: the last answer). Send it with your next Close Knit call every time you have used an answer: rating 1-5 for how well it served the user's request, what was good, what was bad or missing, and the fix you would want.
